tools.name: search_recalls
tools.description: Free. Search U.S. product recalls from CPSC, FDA, NHTSA and FSIS by keyword, brand, model or source. No api_key required. This is the free hook — use get_recall_detail or check_upcs for the unified/paid data.

tools.name: list_agencies
tools.description: Free. Lists the four U.S. federal agencies Recalert covers, with how many recalls are indexed from each and when each was last updated. No api_key required.

tools.name: check_upcs
tools.description: Paid — the main action. Cross-checks up to 500 UPCs against Recalert's unified recall database in one call. Requires api_key (get one free at https://recalert.us/en/data). Costs 10 credits per UPC checked ($0.01/UPC).

tools.name: get_recall_detail
tools.description: Paid. Returns the full unified-schema record for one specific recall (fuente + numero_oficial): hazard, remedy, manufacturer, distributor, official URL, and versioned metadata. Requires api_key. Costs 2 credits ($0.002).

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Free. Returns Recalert's pricing: human subscription tiers (Starter/Pro/Business) and the agent/API credit packages and per-call costs for this MCP server. No api_key required.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_recalls" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
